title: Binance Simple Earn documented in updated Binance Earn guide
description: Binance Academy's updated June 2026 guide described Simple Earn flexible and locked products and separated Simple Earn from higher-risk Advanced Earn strategies, confirming continued product operation.
notes: This is a current-operation milestone, not the launch date of Simple Earn.

title: Jurisdiction-specific Simple Earn risk terms reviewed
description: CYA verified current Binance jurisdiction-specific Simple Earn risk disclosures that distinguish the product from deposits and describe lending, segregation, priority-repayment and bankruptcy-return risks.
notes: The review date records CYA's verification of current terms and is not presented as the original publication or launch date.

title: Bitget launches Flexible Savings
description: Bitget launched Flexible Savings on 24 June 2022 with USDT, DOT and NEAR products, establishing the predecessor product line later represented within Bitget Earn and Simple Earn.
notes: This launch applies to predecessor Flexible Savings, not the exact launch of the later Simple Earn brand.

title: Current Bitget Simple Earn risk terms updated
description: Bitget's Simple Earn Terms were updated on 29 September 2025 and documented third-party asset management, protocol risk, Bitget credit and operational risk, and the absence of guaranteed principal return or displayed rewards.
notes: This is a terms-update milestone and does not imply a status change or product failure.
